specs: Unique digital axe arcade games and outdoor lanes at Marietta location
League nights and competitive games available

blurb: American Axes offers axe throwing at their locations in Marietta and Atlanta, and via mobile trailers at your event. Guests receive instruction and can compete in a variety of games. Both walk-in and reserved bookings are available, with private/group packages and whole venue rentals for events. Mobile experiences can be customized for event needs.
